sources.title: Hendricks closing part of Circle Centre Mall ahead of $300M first phase of revamp

claims.evidence: Circle Centre Mall closed on Dec 31, 2025. Hendricks Commercial Properties owns it and is rebuilding it as an open-air district, with the south block finished around 2030. Tenants in the south block have moved out.
claims.action: Removed Circle Centre Foot Locker from the Home opportunity doors. Removed or reworded Circle Centre in retail-landscape and retail-behavior places, doors, summary, insights and verify lists. Marked factcheck verdict 31 corrected.

claims.claim: A Nike Factory Store operates at the Edinburgh Premium Outlets, about 30 miles south of Indianapolis.
claims.evidence: The official page for Indiana Premium Outlets in Edinburgh lists Nike Factory Store among its shops. The center is about 30 miles south of Indianapolis on I-65 at exit 76B. Its official name is Indiana Premium Outlets; locals call it the Edinburgh outlets.
claims.action: No change needed. Factcheck verdict 31 now records the check.

claims.claim: Hinkle is the 1928 barn where Milan won in 1954 and the state finals were played through 1971.
claims.evidence: Butler Fieldhouse opened in 1928 and hosted the boys' state finals from 1928 to 1971, with a wartime break. Milan beat Muncie Central there on March 20, 1954, on Bobby Plump's last-second shot.
claims.action: No change needed. Added the source to factcheck verdict 36.
